title: Pricing: Setup builder

fields.label: Lead form
fields.name: setup_form
fields.instructions: WPForms form shown on the last step. Use the form for this page's language. Empty = the form titled "Pricing setup offer (EN/PL)".

fields.label: Answers
fields.name: setup_industry_options
fields.instructions: Copied once to new translations; an empty translation shows the English answers. The key is a fixed code used for analytics and case-study matching: keep it identical in every language.

fields.label: Answers
fields.name: setup_equipment_options
fields.instructions: Copied once to new translations; an empty translation shows the English answers. The key is a fixed code used for analytics and case-study matching: keep it identical in every language.

fields.label: Answers
fields.name: setup_challenge_options
fields.instructions: Copied once to new translations; an empty translation shows the English answers. The key is a fixed code used for analytics and case-study matching: keep it identical in every language.

fields.label: Gateway note
fields.name: setup_machines_note
fields.instructions: {sensors} is replaced with the sensors per gateway.

fields.label: Slider points
fields.name: setup_stops
fields.instructions: Comma separated, ascending. Evenly spaced on the slider; the last one is shown as "N+". Synchronized.

fields.label: Sensors per gateway
fields.name: setup_sensors_per_gateway
fields.instructions: Gateways = points ÷ this, rounded up. Synchronized.

fields.label: Case studies
fields.name: setup_cases
fields.instructions: The result shows the best match: same equipment → same challenge → same industry. On a tie the higher row wins, so keep the most generic cases on top. Tick the answer keys from the Questions tabs. Copied once to new translations; an empty translation uses the English list. The case study opens in the visitor's language.

fields.label: Send confirmation email
fields.name: setup_email_enabled
fields.instructions: Emails the person who submitted the lead form, with their setup summary. Same setting for every language.

fields.label: Summary heading
fields.name: setup_email_summary_title
fields.instructions: Heading of the setup summary box in the email.

fields.label: Email text
fields.name: setup_email_body
fields.instructions: Paragraphs separated by an empty line. Placeholders: {name} = first name from the form, {summary} = the setup summary box (keep it on its own line).

fields.label: Footer
fields.name: setup_email_footer
fields.instructions: Small text at the bottom of the email. Emails and www. addresses become links.

description: The setup builder funnel on the Pricing page (partials/setup-builder.php). Empty fields fall back to the English page, then to built-in English defaults.
